name: K1 GEEK
summary: Entry-level configuration of Booster Robotics' K1 humanoid platform: Qualcomm QCS8550 compute (48 TOPS dense), a 2Ah battery (Booster: about 20 min walking at 1.1 m/s; RobotShop EU listing: ~30 min at 0.4 m/s), and a 3-month manufacturer warranty. Won the RoboCup 2025 KidSize championship. Source: RobotShop EU listing, 2026-08-16.
specs_note: Entered by robert@humanoid.company from https://eu.robotshop.com/collections/booster-robotics (retrieved 2026-08-16). 10 field(s) not stated by the source and left UNKNOWN. ros_support and simulation_support are recorded TRUE per the source's own comparison table, which states 'Yes' for both -- but the same page's 'Open Software Stack' section qualifies this: 'ROS 2 or Isaac-Sim support may require developer integration rather than being fully built in.' Treat both as SDK-level capability, not out-of-the-box support. AI compute (Qualcomm QCS8550, 48 TOPS) and warranty (3 months) have no dedicated catalogue field and are recorded in `summary` instead. NOTE: source_url is RobotShop EU's Booster Robotics COLLECTION page, not the exact per-SKU product URL -- the precise product-page URL has been requested from the owner and should replace this citation once supplied. CORRECTION 2026-10-19 (owner decision; docs/discovery/K1_SPEED_RUNTIME_CORRECTION_PROPOSAL_2026-10-19.md): walk_speed_ms is now Booster's stated walking speed, 'Walking Speed: 2 m/s', read as up to 2 m/s (discovery claim fc370db3); the previous 0.4 m/s was the RobotShop listing's runtime-test speed, not a walking speed. runtime_minutes is Booster's own observation, '20 min (walking at 1.1 m/s)' (claim c6f067a5), from https://www.booster.tech/booster-k1?target=en observed 2026-10-18. The RobotShop EU listing's alternative observation, '~30 min runtime at 0.4 m/s' (retrieved 2026-08-16), is preserved in the runtime caveat; the two were measured at different speeds and are not interchangeable. SPECIFICATIONS (HO-DATA-30 batch 3, 2026-10-22): has_teleoperation filled from first-party Booster Robotics sources, each quoted in spec_caveats. Capability booleans are set only where the manufacturer states the capability in words (HO-DATA-30 authoring criteria, docs/audit/HO-DATA-30_FEASIBILITY_AND_BATCH3_2026-10-22.md); a negative only where it is stated in words. RETRIEVAL: AGENT_ASSISTED_RESEARCH (docs/26) — raw bodies: https://www.booster.tech/booster-k1 sha256 7784976dc5e8b305…. Retrieved 2026-10-22 by Claude (Opus 5.5 orchestrating Sonnet research agents; every value re-checked against the saved raw body) in a session initiated by Robert Konecny, under research work order 'HO-DATA-STANDING 2026-10-22' (docs/26 §2.1; docs/decisions/DR-D1). evidence.note: ON_REQUEST chosen over PREORDER: the product already exists and ships, it is simply not held in standing stock.

use_case_fits.notes: Entry-level K1 configuration with SDK, ROS2 compatibility and Isaac Sim support stated by the distributor listing, which also cites a RoboCup 2025 KidSize championship (https://eu.robotshop.com/collections/booster-robotics, observed 2026-08-16): a low-cost entry point to the same development platform as the Educational and Professional configurations.
use_case_fits.limitations: About 20 min runtime walking at 1.1 m/s per Booster (~30 min at 0.4 m/s per RobotShop) and a 3-month warranty. ROS 2 / Isaac Sim may require developer integration. Third-party distributor source.

use_case_fits.notes: The distributor listing cites a RoboCup 2025 KidSize championship: a competition platform, and a potential demonstration platform (https://eu.robotshop.com/collections/booster-robotics).
use_case_fits.limitations: A robot-soccer competition result, not a purpose-built entertainment product. Demonstrations or exhibitions are a potential use, not an established event-service capability. About 20 min runtime walking at 1.1 m/s per Booster (~30 min at 0.4 m/s per RobotShop).

spec_caveats.text: Booster states 'Walking Speed: 2 m/s' (up to 2 m/s; claim fc370db3). A manufacturer specification, not a measured cruising speed.
Booster: '20 min (walking at 1.1 m/s)' (claim c6f067a5). RobotShop EU listing (retrieved 2026-08-16): '~30 min runtime at 0.4 m/s'. Measured at different speeds; not interchangeable.

Booster Robotics states 'Handheld remote controller: Available' / 'Handheld Controller. Responsive and easy to use. Use the thumbsticks to control walking and turning' (https://www.booster.tech/booster-k1). Operator remote control with Booster's handheld controller.
